Placemaker.Issue.RecipeTooDeep.en: This design has too many nested layers.
Placemaker.Issue.RecipeTooDeep.zh: 此设计嵌套的图层过多。

Placemaker.Issue.UnknownLayer.en: Unknown layer "{0}" — is a mod missing?
Placemaker.Issue.UnknownLayer.zh: 未知图层“{0}”——是否缺少模组？

Placemaker.Legend.issues.zh: 问题（红色：已省略；橙色：警告）

Placemaker.Legend.Area.node.zh: 位于道路节点上的角点

Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.SteepPath.en: Some paths climb steeper than is comfortable: the ground is too steep to grade them without big cuts.
Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.SteepPath.zh: 部分步道坡度过大：地面太陡，若不大量挖方就无法平整。

Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.Failed.en: Paths and pads could not be graded ({0}). They follow the ground as it is.
Placemaker.Harmony.Issue.Failed.zh: 无法平整步道和平台（{0}），将保持原有地形。

Placemaker.Issue.CutoutNotZonable.en: A shop plot faces no road the game zones from. It is left to the park.
Placemaker.Issue.CutoutNotZonable.zh: 商店地块没有朝向可供游戏分区的道路，该地块将保留给公园。

Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsKept.en: {0} buildings are in the way. They are kept: nothing is built on their lots.
Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsKept.zh: 有 {0} 栋建筑阻挡。将保留这些建筑，不在其地块内建造。

Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsLeftOut.en: {0} parts were left out or cut back to keep clear of existing buildings.
Placemaker.Issue.BuildingsLeftOut.zh: 为避开现有建筑，已省略或缩减 {0} 个部分。

Placemaker.Problem.OnlyBuildings.en: Only things the brush rules keep off are under the paint (buildings, other builds, zoning, water). Paint somewhere else, or change the rules.
Placemaker.Problem.OnlyBuildings.zh: 涂绘范围内只有笔刷规则要求避开的对象（建筑、其他建造成果、分区或水域）。请换个位置涂绘，或修改规则。

Placemaker.Hint.BuildingsKept.en: {0} buildings in the selection stay: nothing is built on their lots.
Placemaker.Hint.BuildingsKept.zh: 所选区域内的 {0} 栋建筑将保留，不在其地块内建造。

Placemaker.Settings.PaintAvoidBuildings..en: Plain Paint cuts building lots out of the painted area (shaded red while painting). Off = the old behaviour: the outline covers buildings, and the build still leaves them standing.
Placemaker.Settings.PaintAvoidBuildings..zh: 普通涂绘会排除建筑地块（涂绘时显示为红色阴影）。关闭后沿用旧行为：轮廓覆盖建筑，但建造时仍保留建筑。

Placemaker.Why.AreaTooSmall.en: Needs a bigger area (at least {0} m²).
Placemaker.Why.AreaTooSmall.zh: 需要更大的区域（至少 {0} m²）。

Placemaker.UI.Area.HowDraw.en: Click corners, then the first one
Placemaker.UI.Area.HowDraw.zh: 依次点击角点，再点击起点闭合

Placemaker.UI.Area.HowPaint.zh: 拖动涂绘，按住右键拖动擦除

Placemaker.UI.Area.PointsNodes.en: Over a junction a corner snaps to the road node; two in a row follow the road. Alt: no snapping.
Placemaker.UI.Area.PointsNodes.zh: 在路口上方，角点会吸附到道路节点；连续两个角点会沿道路延伸。按住 Alt 禁用吸附。

Placemaker.UI.Arrangement.Hint.en: Repeats in this order along the edges
Placemaker.UI.Arrangement.Hint.zh: 沿边缘按此顺序重复排列

Placemaker.UI.Build.GroupTip.en: On: it is built as one asset. Click it to select all of it; the bulldozer removes all of it. Off: built as separate pieces you click, change and bulldoze one at a time. Removing all of it then takes Remove in a piece's info panel. You can ungroup or group it again later from there.
Placemaker.UI.Build.GroupTip.zh: 开启：作为一个资产建造，点击可选中整体，推土机可移除整体。关闭：各部分独立建造，可分别选中、修改和拆除；如需全部移除，请使用任一部分信息面板中的“移除”。之后也可在该面板中重新组合或取消组合。

Placemaker.UI.Build.KeepAreaTip.en: On: after building, the area stays selected and Placemaker stays open, so you can build something else there. Off: Build closes Placemaker.
Placemaker.UI.Build.KeepAreaTip.zh: 开启：建造后保留区域选择并保持 Placemaker 打开，方便继续建造其他内容。关闭：建造后关闭 Placemaker。

Placemaker.UI.Feature.NoRoom.en: No room for it in this area.

Placemaker.UI.Feature.SomeMissing.zh: 可在 {1} 个位置中的 {0} 个位置放置。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.StallAngle.Ti.en: How the spaces sit against the driving lane. Angled spaces are easier to drive into but fit fewer cars.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.StallAngle.Ti.zh: 车位与行车通道之间的夹角。斜列车位更容易驶入，但可容纳的车辆更少。

Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.90.Tip.en: Spaces at right angles to the lane. Fits the most cars.
Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.90.Tip.zh: 车位与通道垂直，可容纳最多车辆。

Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.60.Tip.en: Slanted spaces, a little easier to drive into.
Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.60.Tip.zh: 倾斜排列的车位，驶入较容易。

Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.45.Tip.en: Strongly slanted spaces. Easiest to drive into, fits the fewest cars.
Placemaker.Parking.StallAngle.45.Tip.zh: 倾角较大的车位，最容易驶入，但可容纳车辆最少。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Entrances.Tip.en: Where cars and people get in and out. We put entrances on the nearest street for you; pick a type, click the outline next to a street to add one, right-click one to remove it.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Entrances.Tip.zh: 车辆和行人的出入位置。系统会在最近的街道旁放置出入口；选择类型后点击临街轮廓即可添加，右键点击已有出入口可移除。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Entrance.Tip.en: Cars come in and go out here. Joins the street without changing it.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Entrance.Tip.zh: 车辆从这里驶入和驶出，连接街道但不改变街道。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Alley.Tip.en: Cars come in and go out through a real junction: the kerb opens and the street gets a crossing. Uses a few building plots on the street.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Alley.Tip.zh: 通过真实路口供车辆进出：打开路缘并在街道上形成交叉口，会占用少量临街建筑地块。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip.en: A junction where cars can only drive in. Needs a way out somewhere else.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyIn.Tip.zh: 仅供车辆驶入的路口，需要在其他位置设置出口。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip.en: A junction where cars can only drive out. Needs a way in somewhere else.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.AlleyOut.Tip.zh: 仅供车辆驶出的路口，需要在其他位置设置入口。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Footpath.Tip.en: A path for people only, from the lot to the sidewalk. Does not count as a car entrance.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.Footpath.Tip.zh: 从停车场连接到街边人行道的步道，仅供行人使用，不计作车辆出入口。

Placemaker.Parking.Marker.ZoningPatch.Ti.en: Keeps a strip by the street free for buildings at this spot. Width and depth are set under Buildings.
Placemaker.Parking.Marker.ZoningPatch.Ti.zh: 在此位置沿街预留建筑用地，宽度和深度在建筑设置中调整。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.EdgeZoning.Ti.en: Leaves a strip next to the street for buildings to grow on. The lot shrinks to make room.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.EdgeZoning.Ti.zh: 沿街预留一条供建筑生成的用地，停车场会相应缩小。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoneType.Tip.en: What may be built there: homes, shops, offices… Automatic uses the city's usual zone.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoneType.Tip.zh: 允许生成的建筑类型：住宅、商店、办公楼等。自动模式使用城市常用的分区类型。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningDepth.T.en: How many plots deep the buildings reach, counted from the street (one plot is 8 m, the game allows up to 6).
Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningDepth.T.zh: 建筑用地从街道向内延伸的格数（每格 8 米，游戏最多允许 6 格）。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningPatchWi.en: How many plots wide each building plot marker is (one plot is 8 m).
Placemaker.Parking.Control.ZoningPatchWi.zh: 每个建筑地块标记的宽度格数（每格 8 米）。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.AsphaltSurfac.en: The surface laid under the lanes and spaces.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.AsphaltSurfac.zh: 铺设在车道和车位下方的地面材质。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Greenery.Tip.en: Where grass, trees and bushes go instead of pavement.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Greenery.Tip.zh: 用草地、树木和灌木替代铺装的区域。

Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Edges.Tip.en: Planting along the outline and at the ends of rows. Rows sit back to back.
Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Edges.Tip.zh: 沿轮廓和每排末端绿化，车位排背靠背布置。

Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Medians.Tip.en: Also a planted strip between back-to-back rows. Costs some spaces.
Placemaker.Parking.Greenery.Medians.Tip.zh: 还会在背靠背的车位排之间设置绿化带，因此会减少部分车位。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.RowAngleMode..en: Which way the rows of spaces run.

Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Edge.Tip.en: Rows run parallel to the longest straight side of the outline.
Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Edge.Tip.zh: 车位排与轮廓最长的直边平行。

Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Across.T.en: Rows run at right angles to the longest side.

Placemaker.Parking.RowAngleMode.Fixed.Ti.zh: 自行指定车位排的方向。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Grading.Tip.en: On sloped ground every row of spaces is levelled into a terrace (at most 2 % fall), with gentle ramps (at most 8 %) between the terraces. Off: the lot follows the ground as it is.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Grading.Tip.zh: 在坡地上将每排车位平整成台地（坡度不超过 2%），台地之间以缓坡连接（坡度不超过 8%）。关闭后停车场沿用原地形。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SteepGrade.en: The ground is steep here: levelling the lot moves up to {0} m of earth at its edges.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SteepGrade.zh: 此处地形陡峭：平整停车场会使边缘地形高度最多变化 {0} 米。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.PerimeterRoad.en: A driving lane along the whole outline with a row of spaces on the outside. Off uses the full area for rows.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.PerimeterRoad.zh: 沿整个轮廓布置行车通道，外侧设置一排车位。关闭后整个区域用于排列车位。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.CrossEvery.Ti.en: Spaces between short lanes that join neighbouring rows. 0 = none.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.CrossEvery.Ti.zh: 连接相邻车位排的短通道之间间隔多少个车位。0 表示不设置。

Placemaker.Parking.EntranceStyle.Alley.T.en: Builds a small alley into the street. The street gets a real junction and its kerb opens up; it costs a few zoning cells there.
Placemaker.Parking.EntranceStyle.Alley.T.zh: 修建一条连接街道的小巷。街道会形成真实路口并打开路缘，代价是占用少量分区网格。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.MedianDepth.T.en: Width of the planted strip between back-to-back rows.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.MedianDepth.T.zh: 背靠背车位排之间的绿化带宽度。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.GreenSurface..en: The surface laid where there is no pavement.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.GreenSurface..zh: 未铺装区域使用的地面材质。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Trees.Tip.en: Tree types to plant. Empty = a mix of street trees.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Trees.Tip.zh: 选择树种；留空时混合使用行道树。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Bushes.Tip.en: Bush types to plant. Empty = a mix of bushes.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Bushes.Tip.zh: 选择灌木种类；留空时混合使用多种灌木。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.PlantingDensi.en: How much of the green is planted.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.PlantingDensi.zh: 绿化区域内植物的覆盖密度。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.LanternAsset..en: Which street light to use. Automatic picks single and double lights.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.LanternAsset..zh: 选择使用的路灯，自动模式会选择单头和双头路灯。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.EvShare.Tip.en: Share of spaces with a charger. Chargers stand in the planting behind a pair of spaces, close to the entrance.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.EvShare.Tip.zh: 带充电桩的车位比例。充电桩位于靠近入口的成对车位后方绿化带中。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.AccessibleSha.en: Share of wide spaces for disabled drivers, placed closest to the entrance.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.AccessibleSha.zh: 供残障驾驶员使用的加宽车位比例，这些车位优先布置在入口附近。

Placemaker.Parking.Reason.NeedsEntrance.en: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
Placemaker.Parking.Reason.NeedsEntrance.zh: 至少放置一个车辆出入口：双向出入口或连接车道，或分别设置一个入口和一个出口。人行步道仅供行人使用。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.BadShape.en: This outline crosses itself. Move a corner so the edges don't cross.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.BadShape.zh: 轮廓发生自交。请移动角点，使边缘不再交叉。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooNarrow.en: Too narrow for parking rows once the edge margin is taken off. Make the area wider, or the edge margin smaller.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooNarrow.zh: 扣除边缘留空后，区域太窄，无法排列车位。请加宽区域或减小边缘留空。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.UnreachableStal.en: {0} spaces could not be reached from an entrance and were left out.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.UnreachableStal.zh: 有 {0} 个车位无法从出入口到达，已省略。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.PerimeterRoadDr.en: Too narrow for a lane around the lot - built without it.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.PerimeterRoadDr.zh: 区域太窄，无法设置外围通道，将不建造该通道。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SurfaceGaps.en: {0} m² of pavement or grass is missing: the game cannot display this shape there.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.SurfaceGaps.zh: 有 {0} 平方米的铺装或草地缺失：游戏无法显示该处的形状。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoStalls.en: No parking space fits here. Try a wider area, narrower spaces or no lane around the lot.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoStalls.zh: 没有车位能放入此处。请加宽区域、缩窄车位，或关闭外围通道。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ReservedSpace.en: {0} spaces were left out because something else is already planned there.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ReservedSpace.zh: 有 {0} 个车位与其他已规划内容占用同一位置，已省略。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForCharge.en: No room for chargers: they need planting behind the spaces.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForCharge.zh: 没有充电桩放置空间：需要在车位后方留出绿化带。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForAccess.en: No room for accessible spaces: they need a row of straight (90°) spaces.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.NoRoomForAccess.zh: 没有无障碍车位放置空间：需要一排垂直（90°）车位。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.LotOwnerRejecte.en: The game cannot use this outline as one lot. Smooth out very sharp corners.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.LotOwnerRejecte.zh: 游戏无法将此轮廓作为一个整体地块，请平滑过于尖锐的角。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooManyEntrance.en: At most {0} entrances per lot - {1} were left out.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.TooManyEntrance.zh: 每个停车场最多允许 {0} 个出入口，已省略 {1} 个。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningNoStreet.en: No side of this lot faces a street, so no buildings can grow along it.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningNoStreet.zh: 停车场没有临街边，无法沿边生成建筑。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningPatchNoSt.en: This building plot is not next to a street. Move it to a side that faces one.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningPatchNoSt.zh: 此建筑地块不临街，请移动到朝向街道的一侧。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningStreetToo.en: The street is too far away for buildings this deep. Increase the building depth or draw the lot closer to the street.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningStreetToo.zh: 街道距离太远，当前建筑用地深度不足。请增加用地深度，或将停车场画得更靠近街道。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningLeavesNoR.en: The building strips would leave no room for parking - built without them.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningLeavesNoR.zh: 建筑预留带会占满停车空间，因此不设置这些预留带。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningTrimmed.en: {0} building strips were left out because parking runs through them.
Placemaker.Parking.Issue.ZoningTrimmed.zh: 有 {0} 条建筑预留带与停车区域相交，已省略。

Placemaker.Dress.dressParking.Tooltip.en: Oil in the bays, tyre marks at turns and entrances, repaired patches.
Placemaker.Dress.dressParking.Tooltip.zh: 车位中的油渍、转弯和出入口处的轮胎痕迹，以及修补过的路面。

Placemaker.Golf.bays.Tooltip.en: Bays along the covered tee line. Limited by the width of the area.
Placemaker.Golf.bays.Tooltip.zh: 沿有顶棚的发球线排列的打位，数量受区域宽度限制。

Placemaker.Recipe.IndustrialWorks.Descri.en: Combined industrial sites: a plant, skips, bays, wrecks and containers, each in its own block of one planned works.
Placemaker.Recipe.IndustrialWorks.Descri.zh: 组合工业场地：工厂、垃圾箱、作业区、报废车辆和集装箱，分别布置在统一规划的各个区块中。

Placemaker.Landfill.fill.Tooltip.en: How much waste lies about: on the face, in the bays, in the dumps.
Placemaker.Landfill.fill.Tooltip.zh: 作业面、隔间和倾倒区中堆放的垃圾数量。

Placemaker.RestArea.truckBays.Tooltip.en: Long, wide stalls and wider aisles for trucks and coaches.
Placemaker.RestArea.truckBays.Tooltip.zh: 为卡车和长途客车设置更长、更宽的车位和更宽的通道。

Placemaker.RestArea.evShare.Tooltip.en: Share of the stalls with a charger.
Placemaker.RestArea.evShare.Tooltip.zh: 配备充电桩的车位比例。

Placemaker.Scrapyard.Issue.NoCore.en: The yard is too small for a central scrap heap; only the edge bays were filled.
Placemaker.Scrapyard.Issue.NoCore.zh: 场地太小，无法放置中央废料堆，仅填充边缘作业区。

Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStand.Issue.Fewer.zh: 计划 {1} 个农产品摊位，仅能容纳 {0} 个。

Placemaker.AddOn.Shops.Issue.Fewer.zh: 计划 {1} 个餐饮摊位，仅能容纳 {0} 个。

Placemaker.UI.LockedHint.en: Click to let Randomize change it again.
Placemaker.UI.LockedHint.zh: 点击以允许随机生成再次修改此项。

Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.ExactPick.zh: 选择具体分区（含模组分区）…

Placemaker.UrbanFarm.soilPaint.Tooltip.en: Paints the terrain texture under the crop fields. Permanent.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.soilPaint.Tooltip.zh: 涂绘农田下方的地形纹理。此改动为永久性。

Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.fence.Toolti.en: A small fence round the bee yard with a gate towards the middle.
Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.fence.Toolti.zh: 在养蜂场周围设置小围栏，大门朝向中央。

Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.wildflowers..en: Flower beds round the back of the bee yard.

Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStall.crates.Toolti.en: Crates of produce either side of the stall.
Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStall.crates.Toolti.zh: 摊位两侧摆放的农产品箱。

Placemaker.Recipe.UrbanRuins.Description.en: A skate spot among the ruins of a broken-down highway: pillars, fallen deck, DIY ramps, graffiti and dirt jumps.
Placemaker.Recipe.UrbanRuins.Description.zh: 在废弃高速公路遗迹间设置滑板场：桥墩、坍塌桥面、自制坡道、涂鸦和土坡跳台。

Placemaker.Ruins.subtype.Tooltip.en: What the ruins became. Each type lays the spot out differently.
Placemaker.Ruins.subtype.Tooltip.zh: 遗迹改造后的用途，每种类型有不同的布局。

Placemaker.Ruins.skateItems.Tooltip.en: Ramps, rails and boxes in lines on the pads under the highway; ramps at the ends face in.
Placemaker.Ruins.skateItems.Tooltip.zh: 高速公路下的平台上排列坡道、栏杆和箱体，两端的坡道朝向内部。

Placemaker.Ruins.graffiti.Tooltip.en: Graffiti on pillars, walls, blocks and along the pads.
Placemaker.Ruins.graffiti.Tooltip.zh: 桥墩、墙面、混凝土块和平台沿线的涂鸦。

Placemaker.Ruins.decay.Tooltip.en: How ruined it is: rubble on the fallen spans, cracks, faded markings.
Placemaker.Ruins.decay.Tooltip.zh: 破败程度：坍塌桥跨上的碎石、裂缝和褪色标线。

Placemaker.Ruins.overgrowth.Tooltip.en: Wild plants reclaiming the edges and the fallen deck.
Placemaker.Ruins.overgrowth.Tooltip.zh: 覆盖边缘和坍塌桥面的野生植物。

Placemaker.Ruins.deck.Tooltip.en: The old highway line: pillar pairs, spans that stand or have fallen.
Placemaker.Ruins.deck.Tooltip.zh: 旧高速公路的路线：成对桥墩，以及仍然矗立或已经坍塌的桥跨。

Placemaker.Fairground.layout.Tooltip.en: Avenue: a main avenue with side streets. Loop: a promenade round the arena. Grid: market aisles. Court: food trucks round a dining court.
Placemaker.Fairground.layout.Tooltip.zh: 大道：主轴与支街；环路：环绕活动区的步道；网格：市场通道；庭院：围绕用餐区布置餐车。

Placemaker.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip.en: Promenade: one pedestrian street. Grand: a wide one. Loop: a pedestrian loop with shops on both sides. Lifestyle centre: the street, plaza and green inside a ring drive, lots outside, paseos through the rows.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip.zh: 步行长街：一条步行街；宏伟型：更宽的步行街；环路：两侧商店环绕的步行街；生活商业中心：环形车道内设置街道、广场和绿地，外侧为停车场，以步行连廊穿过各排。

Placemaker.Market.stalls.Tooltip.en: Stalls on a square of 0.4 ha. A bigger square gets more, in proportion (up to four times as many), so the market fills it.
Placemaker.Market.stalls.Tooltip.zh: 以 0.4 公顷广场为基准的摊位数。更大的广场会按比例增加（最多四倍），使市场铺满场地。

Placemaker.Recipe.MarketSquare.Descripti.en: A paved square with market stalls, a tree ring and a centrepiece.
Placemaker.Recipe.MarketSquare.Descripti.zh: 带市场摊位、环形植树和中心景观的铺装广场。

Placemaker.Commercial.plotTrees.Tooltip.en: Trees and shrubs at the back of each plot, on painted lawn. A building that grows clears what is in its way; the rest stays green.
Placemaker.Commercial.plotTrees.Tooltip.zh: 在各地块后方涂绘草坪并种植树木和灌木。建筑生成时会清除占地内的植物，其余部分保留绿化。

Placemaker.Polish.hug.Tooltip.en: A side or back nobody else has grows out to a road, path or building near it and hugs it.
Placemaker.Polish.hug.Tooltip.zh: 没有相邻地块的侧边或后边可延伸到附近的道路、步道或建筑，并贴合其边界。

Placemaker.Polish.parkStyle.Tooltip.en: How a car park yard looks. Clean: a wide grass edge, trees in planters at the ends of the rows, a tidy bin corner. Everyday: grass edges, bins and stock, most bays taken. Industrial: concrete, no grass, more vans, pallets, barrels, skips and containers, dry worn ground further out.
Placemaker.Polish.parkStyle.Tooltip.zh: 停车场庭院风格。整洁：宽草边、排尾花箱中的树木和整齐的垃圾桶角。日常：草边、垃圾桶与货物，多数车位停满。工业：混凝土、无草地，更多货车、托盘、桶、垃圾箱和集装箱，外围为干燥磨损地面。

Placemaker.Waterfront.beds.Tooltip.en: Beds of low flowering shrubs in the bays behind the promenade.
Placemaker.Waterfront.beds.Tooltip.zh: 在滨景步道后方的空隙中布置低矮开花灌木花坛。

Placemaker.Build.NothingToBuild.zh: 此设计没有可建造的内容。

Placemaker.Build.PlanHasErrors.zh: 请先解决设计中的问题，再开始建造。

Placemaker.Build.CatalogNotReady.en: Assets are still loading. Try again in a moment.
Placemaker.Build.CatalogNotReady.zh: 资产仍在加载，请稍后重试。

Placemaker.Build.ReplaceFailed.zh: 无法移除原有版本，因此未作任何更改。

Placemaker.Build.Interrupted.en: The build was interrupted because another tool was opened. Nothing was built.
Placemaker.Build.Interrupted.zh: 由于打开了其他工具，建造已中断，未建造任何内容。

Placemaker.Build.Timeout.en: The game did not create the parts in time. Nothing was built.
Placemaker.Build.Timeout.zh: 游戏未及时生成各个部分，未建造任何内容。

Placemaker.Build.Failed.en: Building failed unexpectedly. Nothing was kept. Details are in the log.
Placemaker.Build.Failed.zh: 建造意外失败，未保留任何内容。详情请查看日志。

Placemaker.Build.NothingMaterialized.en: The game accepted none of the parts. Nothing was built.
Placemaker.Build.NothingMaterialized.zh: 游戏未接受任何部分，未建造任何内容。

Placemaker.Build.EverythingCollides.en: Every part collides with something. Nothing was built.
Placemaker.Build.EverythingCollides.zh: 所有部分都与现有对象发生碰撞，未建造任何内容。

Placemaker.Build.ApplyRejected.en: The game rejected the build. Nothing was kept.
Placemaker.Build.ApplyRejected.zh: 游戏拒绝了本次建造，未保留任何内容。

Placemaker.Build.Duplicated.en: The build came out doubled (parts placed twice), so it was removed again. Nothing was kept. Please try again; details are in the log.
Placemaker.Build.Duplicated.zh: 建造成果出现重复（同一部分被放置两次），因此已全部移除。请重试，详情见日志。

Placemaker.Build.AssetsUnavailable.en: None of the assets this design needs are available in this playset.
Placemaker.Build.AssetsUnavailable.zh: 当前播放集中没有此设计所需的任何资产。

Placemaker.Audit.Reason.zoning.zh: 预览中显示，但未划分分区

Placemaker.Build.OwnerUnavailable.zh: 此建造成果只能逐个部分选中。

Placemaker.Build.PartsDropped.zh: 建造完成，但有 {0} 个部分无法放置。

Placemaker.Build.AssetsMissing.zh: 建造完成。当前播放集中缺少部分资产，已跳过。

Placemaker.Ghost.Failed.zh: 无法生成实体预览，改为显示草图。

Placemaker.Build.TerraformIncomplete.en: Built. The terrain could not be fully shaped in time.
Placemaker.Build.TerraformIncomplete.zh: 建造完成，但地形未能及时完成全部塑形。

Placemaker.Build.NoWater.en: Built. The lake basin is too shallow, so no water was added.
Placemaker.Build.NoWater.zh: 建造完成。湖盆过浅，因此未添加水体。

Placemaker.Build.Error.InvalidShape.zh: 某个区域的形状不受游戏支持。

Placemaker.Build.Error.NotEnoughClearanc.zh: 部分内容没有足够净空。

Placemaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip.en: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip.zh: 街道在所选区域内的布局方式。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Too.en: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Too.zh: 直线街道组成规则网格，并与所选区域的最长边对齐。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too.en: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too.zh: 沿区域布置一条集散道路，支路末端成对形成尽端路。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.organic..en: Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.organic..zh: 蜿蜒街道搭配尽端路和少量环路，类似郊区住宅街区。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.contour..en: Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.contour..zh: 街道沿地形等高线布置，以缓坡道路连接。需要有坡度的地形。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To.en: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To.zh: 中心为带环岛的放射状道路，外围为自然弯曲的街道。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too.en: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too.zh: 以间距较大的集散道路划分大型街区，各街区内布置环形支路。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo.en: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo.zh: 集散道路围绕 3 × 3 街区组布置，内部街道禁止汽车通行。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr.en: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr.zh: 环路沿区域形状布置，并通过连接街道相互连通。

Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T.en: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T.zh: 从中心环岛向边缘延伸直线主干道，可选用环形道路横向连接。

Placemaker.Scrapyard.level.Tooltip.en: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
Placemaker.Scrapyard.level.Tooltip.zh: 将场地平整为一个平台，并在轮廓处平滑过渡到原地面。此地形改动为永久性。

Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.paintLayer.To.en: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
Placemaker.AddOn.DirtJumps.paintLayer.To.zh: 选择地图四种附加地形纹理中的一种进行涂绘。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage.en: {0} building(s) in this city are outgrown with “{1}”. They are all outgrown again with its new settings, a few at a time in the background.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage.zh: 本市有 {0} 栋建筑采用“{1}”周边美化。它们将按新设置重新美化，并在后台分批处理。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage2.en: That is {0} buildings: every garden, yard and car park of theirs is planned and built again. It cannot be undone in one step (save the old settings as a copy first if you may want them back).
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ApplyMessage2.zh: 将重新规划和建造这 {0} 栋建筑的所有花园、庭院和停车场。此操作无法一步撤销；如需恢复，请先将旧设置保存为副本。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.ByZoneNote4.en: Each building gets the outgrow type its zone type has. Change them in Outgrow (the switcher at the top), or pick any type here to outgrow the area with it.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ByZoneNote4.zh: 每栋建筑使用其分区类型对应的周边美化类型。可在顶部“周边美化”中修改，或在此选择一个类型，应用于所选区域。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.ColorTip.en: Its colour on the map (the lens's Types) and in the charts.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.ColorTip.zh: 在地图类型视图和图表中显示的颜色。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.DeleteMessage2.en: Buildings outgrown with “{0}” keep how they look until they are outgrown again; zones that used it go back to their own.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.DeleteMessage2.zh: 采用“{0}”的建筑会保留当前外观，直到再次进行周边美化；原先使用此类型的分区恢复各自默认类型。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.LauncherTip.en: Pick buildings and outgrow their gardens: shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground, planting, by theme.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LauncherTip.zh: 选择建筑并美化其花园：按主题设置共享围栏与绿篱、草坪或地面涂绘，以及植物。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.LiveTip.en: On: the buildings in the selection are outgrown again a moment after every change you make, and the selection stays. Remove outgrow puts them back.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.LiveTip.zh: 开启后，每次修改设置都会稍后重新美化所选建筑，并保留选择。使用“移除周边美化”可还原。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.PlantingTip.en: What is planted and placed in the land: Garden (lawns, beds, a sand pit or a bench), Natural (wild ground, rocks, logs), Tidy (lawns, hedges, flower beds), Yard (worn ground, pallets, rubble). The rows below fine-tune it.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.PlantingTip.zh: 选择场地中的植物和设施：花园（草坪、花坛、沙坑或长椅）、自然（野地、岩石、原木）、整洁（草坪、绿篱、花坛）、场地（磨损地面、托盘、瓦砾）。可用下方选项细调。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.PolishAll.ByZone3.en: Every building is outgrown with its zone type's default outgrow type, also the ones you brushed another type onto (zone types set to Off are left out). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.PolishAll.ByZone3.zh: 按各自分区的默认类型美化所有建筑，包括曾用笔刷指定其他类型的建筑；设为关闭的分区除外。后台每次处理少量建筑，以保持游戏流畅。

Placemaker.UI.Polish.ResetBuiltIn.zh: 将 {0} 恢复为内置设置

Placemaker.UI.Polish.SaveBuiltIn.en: Save: this is what {0} is from now on, everywhere it is used
Placemaker.UI.Polish.SaveBuiltIn.zh: 保存后，所有使用 {0} 的位置都采用此设置

Placemaker.UI.Polish.UnpolishAll.Message.en: The outgrown buildings go back to how the game made them: fences, hedges and lawns back, the beds, paths, bushes and paving taken away (ground paint stays). It runs in the background a few hundred at a time.
Placemaker.UI.Polish.UnpolishAll.Message.zh: 已美化建筑将恢复为游戏原始外观：还原围栏、绿篱和草坪，移除新增花坛、步道、灌木和铺装；地形涂绘会保留。后台每批处理数百栋建筑。

Placemaker.UI.Preview.RealTip.en: See-through game models and textures, exactly what will be built.
Placemaker.UI.Preview.RealTip.zh: 以半透明游戏模型和纹理展示实际将建造的内容。

Placemaker.UI.Preview.SketchTip.en: Fast outlines and dots. Best while drawing and trying things.
Placemaker.UI.Preview.SketchTip.zh: 快速显示轮廓和点位，适合绘制区域和尝试方案时使用。

Placemaker.UI.Review.AckLong.zh: 确认：部分改动为永久性

Placemaker.UI.Review.AckTip.en: Some changes stay after you remove the build (the amber tags). Click it to allow them.
Placemaker.UI.Review.AckTip.zh: 移除建造成果后，部分改动仍会保留（以琥珀色标签标示）。点击表示允许这些改动。

Placemaker.UI.Review.ChecksSub.en: warnings and things to look at before building
Placemaker.UI.Review.ChecksSub.zh: 建造前的警告与注意事项

Placemaker.UI.Review.PaintOnly.en: Ground paint stays when the build is removed.
Placemaker.UI.Review.PaintOnly.zh: 移除建造成果后，地形涂绘仍会保留。

Placemaker.UI.Preset.CantSave.en: This style can't be saved over

Placemaker.UI.Preset.DeleteText.en: Your style is removed. Builds stay as they are.
Placemaker.UI.Preset.DeleteText.zh: 将删除你的样式，现有建造成果保持不变。

Placemaker.UI.Preset.ResetText.en: Your changes to this style are dropped.
Placemaker.UI.Preset.ResetText.zh: 将放弃你对此样式的修改。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoteCompanion.en: A small hidden park building at the road edge carries these stats, like a vanilla park.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoteCompanion.zh: 道路边缘的隐藏小型公园建筑负责承载这些属性，机制与原版公园相同。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Outside.en: Some values are beyond what vanilla parks this size have; the city may feel unbalanced.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Outside.zh: 部分属性超出同等规模原版公园的范围，可能影响城市平衡。

Placemaker.Park.tennisCourtsPath.Tooltip.en: Adds a short path from the nearest path to the courts' gate.
Placemaker.Park.tennisCourtsPath.Tooltip.zh: 从最近的步道连接一条短步道到球场大门。

Placemaker.Polish.zoneOutgrow.Tooltip.en: Each zone type's own Outgrow switch and settings (set in the panel).
Placemaker.Polish.zoneOutgrow.Tooltip.zh: 每个分区类型各自的周边美化开关和设置（在面板中调整）。

Placemaker.Campground.pitchSize.Tooltip.en: Side length of each pitch. Tents need about 8 m, caravans 12 m or more.
Placemaker.Campground.pitchSize.Tooltip.zh: 每个营位的边长。帐篷约需 8 米，房车需 12 米或更多。

Placemaker.Campground.Issue.NoPitches.en: No pitch fits along the paths. Try a smaller pitch size or a larger area.
Placemaker.Campground.Issue.NoPitches.zh: 步道沿线没有可容纳营位的位置。请缩小营位尺寸或扩大区域。

Placemaker.Parking.Control.Setback.Tip.en: A planted strip between the outline and the first spaces. Tidier, costs spaces.
Placemaker.Parking.Control.Setback.Tip.zh: 轮廓与第一排车位之间的绿化带，使布局更整齐，但会减少车位。

Placemaker.Parking.Issue.UnreachableStal.zh: 省略 {0} 个无法到达的车位

Placemaker.TransitPlaza.dropOff.Tooltip.en: Kiss & ride spaces for a quick stop on the kerb lane.
Placemaker.TransitPlaza.dropOff.Tooltip.zh: 路缘车道上的临时接送停车位，供乘客快速上下车。

Placemaker.UI.Info.Missing.en: Some assets it used are missing (a mod or asset pack was removed). Edit to replace them.
Placemaker.UI.Info.Missing.zh: 缺少部分曾使用的资产（可能移除了模组或资产包）。请编辑以替换它们。

Placemaker.UI.Info.Modified.en: Changed with other tools since it was built. Editing rebuilds it from its design.
Placemaker.UI.Info.Modified.zh: 建造后曾被其他工具修改；编辑将按原设计重新建造。

Placemaker.UI.Info.RemoveAsk.en: Remove all of it? Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Placemaker.UI.Info.RemoveAsk.zh: 移除全部内容？旁边生成的建筑会保留。

Placemaker.UI.Info.UngroupAsk.en: Ungroup it? Its pieces are then clicked and bulldozed one at a time. Group again puts it back.
Placemaker.UI.Info.UngroupAsk.zh: 取消组合？之后需逐个选中或拆除各部分，可用“重新组合”恢复整体。

Placemaker.UI.Info.Ungrouped.en: Ungrouped: you click and bulldoze its pieces one at a time. Remove takes all of it.
Placemaker.UI.Info.Ungrouped.zh: 已取消组合，可逐个选中和拆除各部分。“移除”会删除整体。

Placemaker.UI.Manage.CantEdit.en: This was built by an older version and can only be removed.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.CantEdit.zh: 此内容由旧版本建造，目前只能移除。

Placemaker.UI.Manage.Hover.en: Click something you built to edit it
Placemaker.UI.Manage.Hover.zh: 点击已建造的内容进行编辑

Placemaker.UI.Manage.RegroupTip.en: One thing again: a click selects all of it and the bulldozer removes all of it.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.RegroupTip.zh: 重新组合为整体，点击可全选，推土机可一次移除全部。

Placemaker.UI.Manage.RemoveText.en: Everything Placemaker built here (paths, surfaces, objects, roads it added) is bulldozed. Buildings that grew next to it stay.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.RemoveText.zh: 将拆除 Placemaker 在此放置的全部内容（步道、地表、对象及新增道路）。旁边生成的建筑会保留。

Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupText.en: Its pieces become separate: click any tree, bench, path or surface to change it or bulldoze it on its own. The bulldozer then removes one piece at a time, so removing all of it gets hard: use Remove in a piece's info panel for that. You can group it again there.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupText.zh: 各部分将独立，可分别选中、修改或拆除树木、长椅、步道和地表。推土机一次只移除一个部分；如需全部移除，请在任一部分的信息面板中使用“移除”。也可在那里重新组合。

Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupTip.en: Make its pieces separate, so you can click, change and bulldoze each one yourself.
Placemaker.UI.Manage.UngroupTip.zh: 拆分为独立部分，以便分别选中、修改或拆除。

Placemaker.UI.Marker.TwoWayTip.en: Cars drive in and out here.
Placemaker.UI.Marker.TwoWayTip.zh: 车辆可从这里驶入和驶出。

Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkItemTip.en: On: a crosswalk across the street here. Off: the path stops at the sidewalk.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkItemTip.zh: 开启：在此设置过街人行横道。关闭：步道终止于街边人行道。

Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkTip.en: On: the entrances you place next get a crosswalk across the street (the path joins the road at a new junction). Off: the path stops at the sidewalk and the game joins it, with no crosswalk and no cut in the road. Each placed entrance has its own switch below.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.CrosswalkTip.zh: 开启后，新放置的出入口会带过街人行横道，步道在新路口连接道路。关闭后，步道止于人行道，由游戏连接，不设置横道或切分道路。每个已放置的出入口下方都有独立开关。

Placemaker.UI.Markers.NeedNBuild.zh: 再加 {0} 个出入口才能建造

Placemaker.UI.Markers.Placing.en: Click the outline by a road to place one. Right-click removes one. Esc when done.
Placemaker.UI.Markers.Placing.zh: 点击道路旁的轮廓放置，右键点击移除，完成后按 Esc。

Placemaker.UI.Mock.Timeout.en: Planning took too long and was stopped.

Placemaker.UI.ModeOutgrowTip.en: The whole city's outgrow: each zone type's default, the brush, the map lens, the outgrow types and their numbers.
Placemaker.UI.ModeOutgrowTip.zh: 全城周边美化：各分区类型的默认设置、笔刷、地图视图，以及美化类型和数量。

Placemaker.UI.ModePlacemakerTip.en: Make roads, parks, car parks, shops and zones in an area you pick.
Placemaker.UI.ModePlacemakerTip.zh: 在所选区域中建造道路、公园、停车场、商店和分区。

Placemaker.UI.Painter.ThemeTip.zone3.en: Each building gets its zone type's outgrow type (Outgrow, its Defaults)
Placemaker.UI.Painter.ThemeTip.zone3.zh: 每栋建筑使用其分区类型对应的默认周边美化类型。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Applied.Tip.en: The game uses this value for the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Applied.Tip.zh: 此属性已对游戏中的建造成果生效。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Entertainment.Me.en: Wellbeing boost for residents within reach.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Entertainment.Me.zh: 提升服务范围内居民的幸福感。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Leisure.Meaning.en: How much fun one visit gives a citizen looking for something to do.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Leisure.Meaning.zh: 市民每次来访所获得的休闲满足度。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.KeepVanilla.Tip.en: Keeps every value inside what vanilla parks of a similar size use.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.KeepVanilla.Tip.zh: 将各项属性限制在同等规模原版公园的范围内。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoRoad.en: No road edge: only tourism applies.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.NoRoad.zh: 没有临街边，仅旅游吸引力生效。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Note.en: Only attractiveness reaches the game here. The others are saved with the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Note.zh: 此处只有吸引力对游戏生效，其他属性随建造成果保存。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Range.Meaning.en: How far residents walk to enjoy the park (path cost, about metres).
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Range.Meaning.zh: 居民愿意步行前往公园的距离（寻路成本，约等于米数）。

Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Shown.Tip.en: Needs the companion park building (road edge and setting); saved with the build.
Placemaker.UI.ParkStats.Shown.Tip.zh: 需要配套公园建筑（临街边及相应设置）；此值随建造成果保存。

Placemaker.UI.RandomizeTip.zh: 生成新变化，已锁定的值保持不变。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.AllStopsTip.en: Lit when it stops at everything here. Click to turn them all on, or all off when they are all on.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.AllStopsTip.zh: 所有边界限制启用时亮起。点击可全部启用，全部启用后再次点击可全部关闭。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.BlockTip2.en: A stroke stays in what the Paint bucket would fill where it started.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.BlockTip2.zh: 笔刷限制在起点处填充工具所能填充的区域内。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.BuildsTip.en: Keep off what you built with Placemaker.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.BuildsTip.zh: 避开已有的 Placemaker 建造成果。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.LotsTip2.en: Keep off other lots (other mods, extractors).
Placemaker.UI.Rules.LotsTip2.zh: 避开其他地块（其他模组或资源开采设施）。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.RoadsTip2.en: Stop at the curb of every road, its junctions and turning circles.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.RoadsTip2.zh: 沿每条道路的路缘停止，包括路口和弯道。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.SmartTip.en: On: the brush stops at what you switch on below. Off: it paints over everything.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.SmartTip.zh: 开启：笔刷在下方启用的边界处停止。关闭：笔刷可覆盖一切。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.SmoothTip.en: How smooth the painted edge is.

Placemaker.UI.Rules.SnapTip.en: Pulls painted edges this close onto a curb.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.SnapTip.zh: 将涂绘边缘吸附到附近路缘。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.StopsTip.en: What the area never covers, for every tool. Red on the map.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.StopsTip.zh: 所有区域工具都会避开的对象，在地图上显示为红色。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningBuiltTip.en: Keep off zoned cells that have a building.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningBuiltTip.zh: 避开已有建筑的分区网格。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningGridTip.en: Keep off the whole zone grid along the streets, even cells nobody zoned.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningGridTip.zh: 避开沿街的整个分区网格，包括尚未划定用途的格子。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningOffTip.zh: 分区不会阻挡区域扩展。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningTip.en: How much of the zoning the area keeps off.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningTip.zh: 选择区域工具避开哪些分区网格。

Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningZonedTip.en: Keep off every zoned cell, built on or not.
Placemaker.UI.Rules.ZoningZonedTip.zh: 避开所有已划定用途的网格，无论是否已有建筑。

Placemaker.UI.Tool.BucketTip2.en: Click to fill the land up to what it stops at. Shift+click adds more, right-click drops one.
Placemaker.UI.Tool.BucketTip2.zh: 点击填充至边界，Shift+点击可追加区域，右键点击可移除一个区域。

Placemaker.UI.Tool.PaintTip.en: Brush the area on. Right-click erases.
Placemaker.UI.Tool.PaintTip.zh: 用笔刷涂绘区域，按住右键拖动擦除。

Placemaker.UI.Tool.PointsTip2.en: Click corners, then the first one to close. Snaps to curbs, right angles and road nodes: two corners on road nodes follow the road between them.
Placemaker.UI.Tool.PointsTip2.zh: 依次点击角点，再点击起点闭合。支持路缘、直角和道路节点吸附；两个角点落在道路节点上时，会沿它们之间的道路延伸。

Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.GridTip.en: Its lots, in zone cells (one cell is 8 m), the road along the bottom: the solid block is the smallest lot, the lighter one the biggest; each lot picks a size between. Click or drag near a corner to move it.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.GridTip.zh: 以分区网格设置地块尺寸（每格 8 米），下方为道路。深色矩形表示最小地块，浅色表示最大地块，各地块在此范围内选择大小。点击或拖动角点附近可调整。

Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeEditTip.en: Nothing is zoned: the buildings in the area outgrow their lots, each zone type by its own settings (a type not listed: the first one's).
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeEditTip.zh: 不新增分区，仅按各自设置美化已有建筑周边；未列出的类型使用第一项。

Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeZoneTip.en: The empty zone cells of the area get these zones, as lots that start at the road; the buildings there outgrow their lots too.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.ModeZoneTip.zh: 为区域内空闲分区网格设置这些用途，从道路向内形成地块；同时美化区域内已有建筑周边。

Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.RoadTip3.en: Allowed road width: the roads this zone may line, by their width (two lanes 16 m, four lanes 24 m, six lanes 32 m). Its lots are only placed along roads in this range.
Placemaker.UI.ZoneMix.RoadTip3.zh: 此分区允许临接的道路宽度（双车道 16 米，四车道 24 米，六车道 32 米）。地块只沿此范围内的道路生成。

Placemaker.UI.Zoning.Sub2.en: zones, and how their lots outgrow
